title: Infirmary, Night
transcript:
Bed four. A water stain on the ceiling tiles, shaped like an open hand.
The drip in his arm is cold.

A woman sits beside the bed with her mask pulled down under her chin.
She thinks he is under. She isn't careful with her face.
She cries the way people cry when they have done it many times: quietly, without moving.

WOMAN:
"Why won't you just say it?"

WOMAN:
"All these times. You never once say it."

She wipes her eyes with the back of her wrist and pulls the mask up.
Her badge turns on its clip. DR. M. VARMA.
